info.name: TalentSphere — Company API
info.description:
Full test suite for the TalentSphere Company Onboarding API.

**Setup:**
1. Set the `base_url` variable to your server URL (default: http://localhost:5000)
2. Run **Auth / Login** first — the collection auto-saves the token to `access_token`.
3. All protected requests use Bearer token auth from that variable.
